description:
Job Description: Data Analyst Intern

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Data Analyst Intern to support our analytics team in collecting, organizing, analyzing, and interpreting data. This opportunity is suitable for fresh graduates and aspiring data professionals who want to develop practical analytical skills and gain industry exposure.

Key Responsibilities

* Collect, clean, validate, and organize data from multiple sources.
* Use Microsoft Excel to perform data analysis and prepare reports.
* Write basic SQL queries to retrieve and analyze data.

description:
**Job Title: Senior Business Analyst**

**Experience: 6-8 Years**

**Time Zone: CST**

**Employment Type:** **Full-time**

**Location: Nanakaramguda, Hyderabad**

**About Position:**

Adtech Corp is looking for a Business Analyst to support Data Democratization initiatives across enterprise systems and data platforms. In this role, the Business Analyst will partner closely with business domain stakeholders, Data Product Managers, Data Engineers, and Analytics teams to gather, analyze, and translate business needs into clear, actionable data and reporting requirements.

This position includes end‑to‑end requirements and analysis activities, including stakeholder interviews, evaluation of existing reports and data sources, documentation of functional and non‑functional requirements, and support of Agile delivery execution. The ideal candidate is experienced in working with enterprise data platforms, understands analytics and reporting concepts, and is comfortable bridging the gap between business users and technical delivery teams.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Work with business stakeholders to elicit, analyze, and document data, reporting, and analytics requirements across multiple business domains.
* Analyze existing reports, dashboards, and datasets to identify gaps, redundancies, data quality issues, and opportunities for standardization or decommissioning.
* Translate business requirements into well‑defined user stories and acceptance criteria in Azure DevOps.
* Partner closely with Data Engineers and Data Analysts to ensure business requirements are correctly implemented in data pipelines, semantic models, and reporting layers.
* Support data validation and reconciliation activities by reviewing source‑to‑target mappings and business rules.
* Coordinate and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), ensuring stakeholder validation and approval prior to production deployment.
* Document business definitions, KPIs, and data logic used in downstream reporting and analytics solutions.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
* As part of the Data Products team, help deliver accurate, complete, and timely data products that meet business needs.
* Support initiatives related to Data Democratization, including self‑service analytics enablement and data literacy efforts.
* Deliver on predefined individual and team goals with a focus on quality and stakeholder satisfaction.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, experience working in enterprise data, reporting, analytics, or business analysis roles.
* Strong quantitative, analytical and data analysis skills.
* Ability to interact with many levels across the organization and to face and deal with issues in a mature and professional manner.
* Ability to prioritize, multi-task, and deliver to fast deadlines.
* Attention to detail and persistent approach to work and someone who is self-directed.
* Hands on writing SQL queries and able to review data within tables and assist data modelers with building data models that answer business questions.
* Experience in Data Analysis for Data & Reporting products.
* Strong hands-on data analysis skills using Python, SQL, Databricks, and Power BI.
* Strong quantitative, analytical and interpretive skills.
* Experience with Oracle, Salesforce data schemas; ability to map data flows from source systems to Databricks.
* Practical experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Ability to multi-task and work in a team environment, while following flexible schedule to meet deadlines.
* Able to present clearly and persuasively, listen and solicit clarification, and respond articulately to questions.
* Follows policies and procedures and supports the organization's goals and values.
* Can coordinate multiple parallel initiatives, communicate changes and progress, and complete deliverables on time and within budget.
* Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in mathematical, written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
* Working knowledge of Databricks/ Snowflake administration/architecture and capabilities.
* Ability to query and display large datasets while maximizing the performance of the workbook.
* Ability to interpret technical or dashboard structure and translate complex business requirements to technical specifications.
* Work with business stakeholders to create valuable reports and dashboards that provide insight, improve/automate processes, or add value to the team.
* High-level competency in Excel (VLOOKUP’s, pivot tables, etc.).
* Understanding of advanced calculations and statistical functions.
* A solid understanding of SQL, relational database management systems, data modeling, and normalization.

title: Order To Cash Data & Business Analytics Expert
description:
**Job title: Order to Cash Data & Business Analytics Expert**
-------------------------------------------------------------

* **Location:** **Hyderabad**
  ---------------------------

**About the job**
-----------------

Sanofi is a global life sciences company committed to improving access to healthcare and supporting the people we serve throughout the continuum of care. From prevention to treatment, Sanofi transforms scientific innovation into healthcare solutions, in human vaccines, rare diseases, multiple sclerosis, oncology, immunology, infectious diseases, diabetes and cardiovascular solutions. As a company with a global vision of drug development and a highly regarded corporate culture, Sanofi is recognized as one of the best pharmaceutical companies in the world and is pioneering the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) with strong commitment to develop advanced data standards to increase reusability & interoperability and thus accelerate impact on global health.

Our Order to Cash (O2C) team aims for excellence, equipping Sanofi with a robust core model, seconded with best of breed digital solutions embedding artificial intelligence and machine learning functionalities. Our international presence, our ambition to become a global reference player for all order to cash related processes mean that our team works on a variety of projects with opportunities for a rich mix of work. This leads to a challenging and stimulating professional experience full of growth and learning. Business Operations is a Global organization of Sanofi providing end to end services to all geographies in Europe, North America, China, JPAC & International regions and covering Global Procurement services, Operations and transition management, medical activities hub, People services, and Global Finance services. Global Finance services homedical following service lines O2C, A2R, Financial sanctions compliance.

Over the past two years, Global Finance Services has doubled in size and increased its scope. As one department within Business Operations, we’re also part of something much bigger. This provides opportunities for learning, growing, job moves and a diversified, fulfilling career. Order To Cash (O2C) service line, one of the pillars of Business Operations Finance services, is currently covering the following areas

* Master data Management
* Sales orders Management
* Requests and Disputes Management
* Credit Risk and Credit Data Management
* Collections and Customer Contact Management
* Cash Application and Receivables Management
* AR related Month-end Closing, Reporting and Non-trade Invoice Management

These operations are critical for customers & patients’ products fulfillment, accurate accounting, generating cash flow, and customer satisfaction.

As Order to Cash Data & Business Analytics Expert within our Global Finance Services Order to Cash team, you'll turn data into insights that improve how we serve customers, collect cash, and run our processes. Ready to get started?

Join the team that powers Sanofi from within, streamlining how we work, scaling bold ideas, and accelerating impact across the business. In our Business Operations Hubs, you'll help shape smarter, data-driven Order to Cash processes (from sales orders to cash application) that support customers and help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. You'll work with colleagues across the globe, using analytics, automation, and AI to drive continuous improvement.

**Main responsibilities:**

  

* Build and improve dashboards, KPIs, and reports that help teams monitor efficiency, spot deviations, and follow process adherence.
* Analyze Order to Cash data and share clear, actionable insights with Global Process Leads, Business System Owners, and Hub teams.
* Translate business needs into Power BI visualizations and turn them into user stories and tasks for developers.
* Train and support colleagues so that data is understood, trusted, and used in everyday decisions.
* Put our data governance approach into practice, keeping data accurate, high quality, secure, and compliant.
* Resolve data quality issues at the source and work with other teams to align data definitions and data sharing across processes.
* Keep master and reference data consistent across systems and applications and check the accuracy of data from internal and external sources.

**About you:**

* **Experience:** Proven experience in analytics and a strong understanding of Order to Cash activities, with good business sense.
* **Technical skills:** Hands-on experience with Power BI and RPA, and solid SAP knowledge. Experience with Agile ways of working, Jira/Confluence, Microsoft Lists, or Python is a plus.
* **Soft skills:** Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, strong problem-solving and analytical thinking, and the ability to train others and present ideas clearly.
* A self-starter who takes initiative, works independently under pressure, and delivers excellent service to customers.
* **Languages:** Excellent English (written and spoken). Other European languages are an advantage.

**Why choose us?**

  

* Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.
* Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
* Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
* Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention, and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.
* Opportunity to work in an international environment, collaborating with diverse business teams and vendors, working in a dynamic team, and fully empowered to propose and implement innovative ideas.

title: Specialist, Business Analyst – AI Content Creation (Content Creation & Storage)
description:
Job Description
  
  
Specialist, Business Analyst – AI Content Creation (Content Creation Storage)
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organization driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the worlds greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  
About Digital Human Health (DHH)
  
Digital Human Health (DHH) connects technology, data, and people to enable and accelerate Human Health business across global markets. DHH supports commercial and medical teams by delivering customer-centric digital platforms, data capabilities, and technology-enabled operating models that enable flexible go-to-market approaches, actionable insights, and personalized customer experiences in a regulated environment.
  
Within DHH, the Content Creation Storage pillar of Digital Content Customer Experience (DCCE) builds the platforms and capabilities that help Human Health create compliant, on-brand content faster. As part of the Content Accelerator, the pillar is moving content creation from manual production to AI-generated content that is built to brand and compliance standards from the start, combining agentic content creation platform, Adobe capabilities (including Adobe Brand Intelligence and Adobe Firefly), design system, and AEM/DAM foundations.
  
  
Role Purpose
  
Act as hands-on business and product partner for AI-enabled content creation, working closely with business users and vendor teams to shape, test, and evolve GenAI and agentic capabilities, and building the internal knowledge needed to confidently own custom components as the platform landscape evolves.
  
Scope of Ownership Adjacent Responsibilities
  
  

* Support the AI Content creation workstream: experiment design, requirements, testing, and assessment of where Adobe capabilities can replace or complement custom-built components.
* Build working ownership of custom agentic components. Understand how they work, maintain requirements and backlog, and guide their evolution with engineering and vendor teams.
* Support the Adobe Firefly rollout across Human Health: access and onboarding inputs, playbook and enablement content, usage reporting, and user feedback loops.
* Work closely with content creators, brand teams, and reviewers to capture real feedback, prioritize the most important items, and turn them into fast, practical iterations.
* Flex across adjacent workstreams in the pillar (e.g., design system, guardrails/rules, AEM/DAM) as priorities shift.

Key Responsibilities
  
Business Analysis Product Ownership Support
  
  

* Translate business and workflow needs into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for AI-enabled content creation capabilities.
* Maintain and prioritize backlogs in partnership with the Product Owner; support sprint planning, refinement, and release readiness.
* Map current-state and future-state content creation workflows, identifying where AI and agents add value and where human review remains essential.
* Facilitate UAT with business, brand, and compliance stakeholders; track defects, gaps, and fixes through to closure.

Hands-on GenAI Agentic Delivery (Embedded with the Business)
  
  

* Work hands-on with GenAI and agentic tools to test, configure, and validate capabilities (e.g., prompts, agent inputs/outputs, brand rules, assembly and validation steps).
* Sit close to business users during pilots and early rollout: observe real usage, unblock issues quickly, and feed priority learnings back into the backlog.
* Design and run structured experiments with clear scope, success criteria, test assets, and results (e.g., accuracy, false-flag rate, turnaround time, rework).
* Build a working understanding of component architecture, integrations, and APIs to have informed discussions with engineering and vendors.

Platform Vendor Collaboration (Adobe and Partners)
  
  

* Serve as a day-to-day contact for Adobe and implementation partners on ABI and Firefly: align on scope, prerequisites, dependencies, and timelines.
* Assess build vs. buy trade-offs for components (custom vs. platform capability) and document recommendations with risks and dependencies.
* Review vendor deliverables (playbooks, guides, configurations) to confirm fit needs and governance.

Documentation, Governance Communication
  
  

* Maintain a clear source of truth (e.g., Confluence, JIRA) covering requirements, decisions, test results, and component documentation.
* Embed compliance-by-design: human-in-the-loop controls, AI labeling, auditability, and alignment with AI and content policies.
* Prepare crisp updates, MoMs, and decision summaries for leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* We have internal capability to understand, maintain, and evolve custom content creation components with reduced dependence on vendors.
* ABI experiments run to plan with clear results that support evidence-based platform decisions.
* Firefly adoption grows across Human Health with users onboarded, enabled, and supported within guardrails.
* Business feedback turns into prioritized improvements quickly, with visible gains in turnaround time, rework, and first-time-right content.
* Requirements, decisions, and component documentation are current, traceable, and reusable.

title: Tech Architect ( Video Analytics )
description:
**Tech Architect (Video Analytics)**

**Engineering / Technology | Hyderabad, India | Full-time | In-office only**

**About the Role**

We are seeking a hands-on Tech Architect to define and drive the technical direction of our SaaS platform. You will architect and build scalable backend web services; design analytics pipelines for drone-captured images and videos; enable enterprise-grade single sign-on (SSO) and a secure, extensible integration layer; and turn proofs of concept (POCs) and prototypes into reliable, production-ready systems. You will also champion AI/LLM-powered agentic coding to improve engineering productivity, while setting high standards for security, quality, scalability, and operational readiness.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Define end-to-end architecture for a multi-tenant SaaS platform, balancing scalability, performance, security, availability, and cost.

· Assess existing POC and prototype code, determine what can be reused versus re-architected, and define a practical path to production and go-live.

· Production-harden prototypes through robust error handling, logging, monitoring, automated testing, security controls, configuration management, and performance tuning.

· Own production-readiness reviews, load and performance testing, CI/CD and deployment strategies (including blue-green and canary releases), rollback plans, and post-launch support.

· Architect scalable analytics pipelines for drone-captured imagery and video, covering live-stream and bulk-field-upload ingestion, processing, model inference, storage, and API-based delivery of results.

· Address drone-data constraints, including large high-resolution media, intermittent or low-bandwidth connectivity, GPS and flight telemetry, altitude, gimbal/camera orientation, timestamps, and mapping data to missions, sites, and assets.

· Make architecture decisions for real-time versus batch processing, GPU/accelerator utilization, edge versus cloud inference, and cost optimization for media-heavy workloads.

· Architect enterprise identity and SSO using SAML 2.0, OIDC, and OAuth 2.0; support per-tenant SSO configuration, integrations with Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, and Google Workspace, SCIM provisioning, RBAC, and session management.

· Design and own the platform’s extensibility and integration layer, including public APIs, webhooks, SDKs, and plugin/extension models for customer, partner, third-party, drone-platform, and fleet-management integrations, with versioning, backward compatibility, and safe sandboxing.

· Own end-to-end security architecture, including API gateway and WAF controls, authentication and authorization, encryption in transit and at rest, secrets and key management, audit logging, and tenant data isolation.

· Drive secure-by-design practices through threat modelling, security reviews of designs and code, dependency and vulnerability management, and penetration-test remediation—including for AI-generated code and third-party extensions/integrations.

· Architect and oversee backend services, including REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, and service-to-service communication.

· Remain hands-on: write and review production-grade backend code, build POCs, and demonstrate engineering standards by example.

· Design core SaaS capabilities such as multi-tenancy, subscription and billing integration, tenant data isolation, rate limiting, and horizontal scalability.

· Lead adoption of AI/LLM agentic coding tools such as Claude Code for delivery acceleration, refactoring, and productionizing prototype code.

· Establish workflows and best practices for AI-assisted software development, including code-review standards, guardrails, and quality gates for AI-generated code.

· Define technical standards, coding guidelines, and architectural patterns across engineering teams; evaluate and recommend technologies, frameworks, tools, and emerging AI/LLM and computer-vision capabilities.

· Partner with product managers and stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.

· Review and approve high-level designs (HLDs), guide low-level designs (LLDs), identify technical debt, and lead legacy-system modernization, using AI-assisted tools where beneficial.

· Ensure architecture meets non-functional requirements for scalability, availability, security, tenant isolation, and observability.

· Mentor senior engineers and tech leads on architecture, productionizing prototypes, and effective use of AI coding assistants.

· Lead POCs for new technologies, LLM/agentic workflows, vision models, and major system changes.

· Collaborate with DevOps/SRE teams on infrastructure, deployment, and CI/CD architecture.

· Own architecture documentation and keep it current across the organization.

**Required Qualifications & Technical Skills**

· 10–15 years of software engineering experience, including significant experience in architecture-focused roles.

· Proven experience building and scaling SaaS products end to end, ideally from early-stage development through growth.

· A demonstrated track record of taking POCs/prototypes to production through refactoring, re-architecture, hardening, and successful live launches with measurable reliability and performance.

· Strong backend engineering experience designing, building, and scaling production REST/GraphQL APIs and microservices.

· Experience designing or building systems that ingest and process drone-generated aerial imagery and video at scale, including use cases such as object detection, change detection, classification, tracking, and inspection.

· Understanding of video streaming protocols (RTSP, RTMP, WebRTC, HLS), encoding/transcoding, and large-scale media storage.

· Experience with drone data and metadata, including geo-tagged imagery, flight telemetry, geospatial context, and data flows from device or ground station to cloud.

· Familiarity with production deployment and serving of computer-vision/ML models, including inference optimization, GPU workloads, batching, and model versioning; exposure to OpenCV, FFmpeg, or similar frameworks.

· Hands-on experience implementing enterprise SSO and authentication using SAML, OIDC, OAuth2, and SCIM in multi-tenant SaaS products, including integration with major identity providers.

· Experience designing extensible platforms with public APIs, webhooks, SDKs, and plugin/extension or third-party integration frameworks, including versioning, rate limiting, and safe extension isolation.

· Strong security architecture skills covering API security, encryption, secrets management, tenant isolation, secure SDLC, threat modelling, and OWASP Top 10 risks and mitigations.

· Mandatory hands-on coding capability; this is an active engineering role, not solely an architecture-review position.

· Practical, demonstrable use of AI/LLM-based agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code) in real engineering workflows, beyond casual use.

· Strong expertise in system design, distributed systems, and microservices architecture.

· Experience with multi-tenant architecture, subscription billing systems, and SaaS scalability patterns.

· Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP, including managed GPU/ML and media services.

· Deep proficiency in at least one major backend language/stack: Java, Python, Node.js, .NET, or Go.

· Deep understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases, data modelling, caching strategies (Redis or Memcached), and object storage.

· Strong experience with API design, API gateways, messaging/streaming systems such as Kafka or RabbitMQ, and service-integration patterns.

· Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing strategies, and production observability, including logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting.

· Understanding of LLM fundamentals—prompting, context management, tool/function calling, RAG, agentic workflows, and multimodal models—sufficient to architect responsible AI integrations.

· Working knowledge of compliance and data-control frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR, including privacy and data-retention considerations for aerial imagery and video. Regulated-industry experience is a plus, not mandatory.

· Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

· Experience leading architecture reviews and building consensus across engineering teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

· Experience with drone SDKs/platforms such as DJI, MAVLink, PX4, or ArduPilot, or with drone fleet and mission-management software.

· Experience with geospatial and photogrammetry tooling, including GIS, orthomosaics, 3D reconstruction, GDAL, or PostGIS.

· Experience with edge/on-device inference or low-latency real-time video processing at a ground station or on a drone.

· Experience with video analytics platforms or stream-processing frameworks such as GStreamer, NVIDIA DeepStream, or Triton Inference Server.

· Experience building a developer ecosystem or marketplace, including partner APIs, app/extension marketplaces, and developer portals.

· Experience with zero-trust architecture, mutual TLS (mTLS), WAF/API-gateway policy design, or security tooling such as SAST/DAST and SIEM integrations.

· Experience with API monetization, usage-based billing, or SaaS metering systems.

· Experience building or integrating LLM-powered applications or agents in production.

· Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar agent-tooling frameworks.

· Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or other containerization and orchestration technologies.

· Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), including Terraform or CloudFormation.

· Experience with SRE practices, including SLOs/SLAs, incident response, and capacity planning.

· Prior experience scaling SaaS systems from startup to enterprise scale.

· Relevant certifications, such as AWS/Azure/GCP Solutions Architect, TOGAF, or security certifications.

**Role Expectations**

· Be a hands-on technical leader who can move fluidly between architecture, implementation, code review, production readiness, and technical mentoring.

· Balance rapid delivery with long-term maintainability, security, reliability, and cost efficiency.

· Build consensus across teams and communicate trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Application note:** Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate hands-on backend engineering, productionizing POCs, SaaS architecture, drone-media/data pipeline design, enterprise SSO and security architecture, and practical use of AI-assisted coding tools.

description:

**Primary Job Title****:** Analyst

**Service Line****:** Platform Services

**Line manager****:** Payroll Lead

**Indirect Manager****:** Payroll & Compliance Officer (Sydney)

**Direct reports****:** None

**About the team and role**

At Quantaco, we deliver state-of-the-art predictive financial data services for the Australian hospitality industry. We are the eighth-fastest growing company in Australia as judged by Australia’s flagship financial newspaper, Australian Financial Review in 2022 and we are accelerating through hyper-automation.

Our Hyderabad team is the cross-functional heartbeat of Quantaco, with team members that sit in each of our service lines. We have a range of disciplines that sit within the Hyderabad team including accountants, engineers, data analysts, operations, and general management.

The Payroll & Compliance Processor will deliver the processing of specialized payroll activities including outer limits and annualized wage reconciliations.

Working with the Payroll & Compliance Officer (in Sydney) and the Payroll Processing team in Hyderabad, the objective of this role is to ensure accurate payroll figures for our clients, using our proprietary and systems processing methods. While our clients are familiar with payroll processing, this role will need to know the intricacies of why we need to process outer limits and conduct annual reconciliations in order to answer any basic queries from clients.

Therefore, the Payroll & Compliance Processor needs to have a keen eye for detail and must love processes and process improvement.

**Our culture and values**

Quantaco is a happy and diverse group of professionals who value authenticity, creativity, and flexibility. We support and work hard for each other and for our customers, having fun along the way. You can see what our team says about Quantaco Life https://www.linkedin.com/company/quantaco/videos/?viewAsMember=true.

**OKRs:**

**Growth & Scale**

* Be the expert in processing outer limits and annualised wage reconciliations for the team in HYD
* Conduct a least 1 training session per quarter (or as appropriate) on the outer limits and annualised wage reconciliation process
* Actively participate and maintain at least 80% attendance in trainings
* Understanding of and knowledge of our payroll processes and where outer limits processing and annualised wage reconciliations fit in
* Roster adherence is 85% or more and office days are at least 3 days a week
* Actively participate in team huddles
* Achieve 98% compliance with all Australian payroll laws each quarter
* Agreed performance metrics (98% completion on time) met or exceeded and Monday.com is live source of truth at all times.
* Maintain 100% compliance in actioning emails within 24 hours
* Review comments from CL/CM/CD are actioned within 24 hours and are not repeated in the following months.

**Satisfaction:**

* Payroll requests and reconciliations are processed in line with the SOP and reviewed to be error free
* Payroll requests are processed every week on time and delivered to clients
* 100% accuracy of payroll processing results
* Answering basic queries from clients and appropriate escalation to the Payroll & Compliance Officer

**Profitability:**

* Ensure follow-through of all client requests for outer limits processing and reconciliations.
* Comply, adapt and improve upon payroll processes to optimise payroll processing time.
* Ensure sufficient processes in place to ensure delivery of outer limits calculations and reconciliations every week.

**Personal attributes**

* Organized, detail-focused and process driven with a love for numbers
* Energetic, loves fast-paced environments, and fast learner
* Dedicated to following processes and procedures with a love for process improvement
* Empathic, humanistic and able to deal with uncertainty
* Self-motivated and can work as an individual and in a team
* Solution-driven with an innate sense of curiosity
* Ability to influence team members to collectively achieve the desired outcome for all stakeholders
* Excellent communicator, patient, and able to explain your ideas verbally, and in writing

**Skill requirements**

* Qualified BCom or other accounting degree
* **Must have minimum payroll experience of 2 years**
* **Must be a minimum of Meets Expectations at last performance review**
* **Must have a demonstrable track record of delivering payroll process and procedure**
* Highly advanced at Excel and familiarity with payroll and time and attendance systems, including Deputy, Tanda, NetSuite, and KeyPay (training will be provided)
* High attention to detail
* Understanding or familiarity with Australian Payroll (particularly, Hospitality Industry Award)
* Loves numbers and analyzing numbers
* Proficient communication skills
* Able to prioritize, multitask and be solution oriented
* Proven advanced accounting knowledge and application skills
* Proficient and comfortable using a range of technology applications
* Previous payroll processing experience.

To be considered for this role, you must complete 3 steps:

  

* Apply to this job on Naukri and upload your resume
* Complete the Skills Tests for this role
* Complete the Psychometric Test for this role

**Note:** If you successfully clear the Skills Test, you will be redirected to a Psychometric Test to assess how you think and make decisions.

You must follow the link below and complete the testing assessments. The first assessment is a Skills Test, to assess your technical ability and numerical reasoning.

To complete these tests, you must go to https://es.peoplogicaskills.com/es/quiz?testId=812f122c23f612b7 and complete the assessments.

**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**

  
  

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. **What you will do**

This role will drive requirements discovery, business process analysis, value realization, and product delivery for AI-powered capabilities across Operations functions.

Business Analysis

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand processes, challenges, reporting needs, and business objectives.

* Gather, analyze, document, and validate business, functional, data, and reporting requirements.

* Facilitate stakeholder discussions, workshops, and requirements for gathering sessions.

* Translate business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, data requirements, and functional specifications.

* Ensure alignment between business expectations and delivered solutions.

* Support User Acceptance Testing, business validation, and defect triage.

**Business Intelligence and Analytics**

* Design, develop, enhance, and maintain dashboards and reports using Tableau and/or Power BI.

* Partner with stakeholders to define KPIs, metrics, scorecards, calculations, and reporting requirements.

* Create intuitive visualizations that communicate business performance, trends, and operational insights.

* Develop executive dashboards, operational reports, and analytical solutions for different stakeholder groups.

* Perform data analysis to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable business insights.

* Ensure dashboard accuracy through data validation, reconciliation, and quality checks.

* Publish, maintain, monitor, and support dashboards in enterprise environments.

* Optimize dashboard performance, usability, accessibility, and adoption.

* Support data mapping, validation, reconciliation, and root-cause analysis across multiple data sources.

* Assist in defining business rules, calculations, transformations, and reporting datasets.

* Troubleshoot reporting, dashboard, and data-related issues and coordinate resolution with technical teams.

* Ensure analytics solutions meet business, quality, security, and compliance expectations.

**Delivery and Support**

* Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.

* Support functional testing, data validation, defect management, release readiness, and post-release verification.

* Create and maintain requirements, dashboard documentation, data definitions, user guides.

* Deliver dashboard demonstrations and solution walkthroughs to business and technical stakeholders.

* Stay current with business intelligence, analytics, visualization, and AI-enabled reporting capabilities.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in information systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, Data Analytics, or related fields.

* 3-5 years of experience in Business Analysis, Business Intelligence, Reporting and Analytics, Data Analysis, or a related role.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Hands-on experience developing dashboards and reports using Tableau and/or Power BI.

* Knowledge of Power BI DAX, Power Query, Tableau calculations, Level of Detail expressions, and dashboard optimization techniques.

* Experience building KPI dashboards, executive scorecards, operational reports, and analytical visualizations.

* Strong SQL skills for data extraction, analysis, validation, and reporting.

* Expected to support RunOps for multiple Applications with knowledge on SaaS and COTS applications.

* Experience gathering, documenting, validating, and managing business and reporting requirements.

* Ability to translate business needs into effective data, dashboard, and analytics solutions.

* Experience creating user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, data requirements, and functional specifications.

* Strong understanding of dashboard design, data visualization, usability, and data-storytelling principles.

* Experience with relational databases, large datasets, data modeling concepts, data quality, and reconciliation.

* Experience publishing, maintaining, and supporting dashboards in enterprise environments.

* Experience supporting UAT, defect management, business validation, and release activities.

* Experience working in Agile or Scrum delivery teams and using Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.

* Strong stakeholder management, analytical, problem-solving, communication, and presentation skills.

* Ability to work effectively with global, virtual, and cross-functional teams.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience in life sciences, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, healthcare, EHSS, manufacturing, or another regulated industry.

* Experience supporting Environmental, Health and Safety, Sustainability, Quality, Compliance, Operations, or Corporate functions.

* Experience with cloud-based data and analytics platforms such as Azure, AWS, Databricks, or Snowflake.

* Understanding data warehousing, ETL/ELT processes, APIs, integrations, and enterprise reporting architectures.

* Familiarity with Python or another analytics-related programming language.

* Exposure AI-assisted analytics, reporting, or business productivity tools.

* Experience supporting enterprise-scale reporting solutions and globally distributed business teams.

* Experience with Generative AI products and solutions

* Understanding of LLMs, copilots, chatbots, and AI assistants

* Prompt engineering concepts

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and critical thinking abilities.

* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder engagement skills.

* Ability to simplify complex data and technical concepts for business audiences.

* High degree of ownership, accountability, initiative, and attention to detail.

* Collaborative mindset with a focus on shared outcomes and business value.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, global, and matrixed environment.

* Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies and business domains.

**Job Summary**

Job Description Summary
  
Are you passionate about service excellence? Would you love to work for a global organization that is doing more good for people and planet?
  
  
IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health & biosciences, we deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products.
  
  
Global Business Services: Delivering streamlined, scalable support—enhancing efficiency, compliance and service excellence across the company.
  
  
The role is based in Hyderabad, India(hybrid role). Be part of a creative, solution-oriented team where together we can achieve greatness and make a real impact. Your potential is our inspiration.

**Where You'll Make a Difference**

* Perform quality audits and transaction reviews to ensure compliance with SOPs, policies, and controls.
* Identify process gaps, defects, and improvement opportunities to enhance operational effectiveness.
* Analyze quality trends and prepare reports, dashboards, and audit documentation.
* Conduct RCA and support CAPA implementation to prevent recurring issues.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to improve quality, reduce risks, and drive process excellence.

**What Makes You the Right Fit**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* 8+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, Process Excellence, Audit, Compliance, or Continuous Improvement.
* Strong knowledge of quality frameworks, controls, risk management, and compliance requirements.
* Experience in RCA, CAPA management, defect analysis, and quality reporting.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

**How Would You Stand Out?**

* Certification in Six Sigma, Lean, FMEA, Quality Management, or Process Excellence methodologies.
* Hands-on experience with Power BI dashboards, data visualization, and trend analysis.
* Exposure to Shared Services, Finance Operations, Procurement, or GBS environments.
* Knowledge of continuous improvement methodologies such as PDCA, DMAIC, and Kaizen.
* Proven track record of driving automation, standardization, and operational excellence initiatives.

**Why Choose Us?**

* Join a global organization focused on innovation, quality, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with diverse teams and stakeholders across regions and functions.
* Contribute to impactful initiatives that strengthen controls and improve business performance.
* Access opportunities for professional growth, learning, and career advancement.
Thrive in a collaborative and inclusive environment that values new ideas and excellence.  

**Important Information Regarding This Position**  
  
For your awareness, IFF has announced its intention to sell its Food Ingredients Business to CVC Capital Partners. The sale is presently expected to close in the first half of 2027, pending regulatory approvals and other closing conditions. title: Master Data Management Analyst
description:
*About the Digital Data Team*

We are an innovative global healthcare company, driven by one purpose: we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. Our team, across some 100 countries, is dedicated to transforming the practice of medicine by working to turn the impossible into the possible. We provide potentially life-changing treatment options and life-saving vaccine protection to millions of people globally, while putting sustainability and social responsibility at the center of our ambitions.

  

Sanofi’s Digital Data organization’s mission is to transform Sanofi into a data-first and AI first organization by empowering everyone with good data. Through custom developed products built on world class data foundations and platforms, the team builds value and a unique competitive advantage that scales across our markets, R&D, and manufacturing sites. The team is in major hubs in Paris, Lyon, Barcelona, Cambridge, Bridgewater and most recently, Toronto, with the aim of opening a new office in Hyderabad. Join a dynamic, fast paced, and talented team, with world class mentorship, using AI and ML to chase the miracle of science.

*About Growing with Us:*

**In this role you will** play a crucial role in ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of our organization's data assets. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, implement, and maintain data management solutions that drive informed decision-making, improve operational efficiency, and increase business values. This will be achieved by the **following:**

* Collaborate with key stakeholders, MDM specialists, and IT (Information Technology) teams to understand master data management (MDM) platform requirements, quality standards, and integration needs.
* Design and implement MDM platform capabilities to ensure master data ingress / egress, accuracy, consistency, and compliance with established standards.
* Maintain legacy and upcoming MDM platforms at Sanofi including but not limited to Semarchy, Informatica, AWS, Oracle RDS, MS SQL Server and JSON APIs.
* Conduct support operations for AWS account management, GitHub, Redis and other platforms
* Manage and optimize data integration processes using tools to ensure seamless data flow between various systems and platforms.
* Perform data profiling, validation, and cleansing to identify and rectify data quality issues.
* Create and maintain documentation for MDM platforms
* Participate in data migration projects, ensuring successful data transfers between different systems and platforms.
* Collaborate with DevOps teams to implement data pipelines, automate data workflows, and ensure continuous integration and deployment.
* Utilize programming skills in Python for data manipulation and transformation tasks.
* Monitor data quality and performance, proactively identifying and addressing issues to ensure optimal data management.
* Excellent communication skills
* Stay up to date with industry trends and emerging technologies related to master data management, cloud computing, and data integration.

*About you*

*Key Functional Requirements & Qualifications:*

* Solid understanding of data management principles, data governance, and data quality best practices.
* Proficiency in designing, developing, and maintaining data integration workflows
* Prior experience in data migration and data governance projects is desirable.
* Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools, enabling seamless integration and deployment of data solutions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a keen eye for identifying data anomalies and quality issues.
* Excellent communication skills to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Proven ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team in a fast-paced environment. Flexibility in learning and adopting new technologies, frameworks and platforms.
* Relevant certifications in data management, cloud computing, or related fields are a plus.

*Key Technical Requirements & Qualifications:*

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or any other related fields. (Advanced degree preferred).
* 5+ years of hands-on experience working with Informatica, Semarchy, MS SQL Server, Oracle, Postgres, and Python.
* Experience with cloud-based technologies, especially AWS services for account management, key rotation, data storage, processing, and analytics.

*When joining our team, you will experience:*

* An international work environment, in which you can develop your talent and realize ideas and innovations within a competent team
* An attractive, market-oriented salary and cafeteria benefits
* Flexible home office policy, with a possibility to work up to 60% of time from home / where you can easily schedule your office days
* Work from an "Office of the Year 2020" finalist office
* Collective life and accident insurance
* Yearly medical check-up
* Exposure to training and certification pathways for technical and functional skills from AWS, Snowflake, Informatica and others
* An individual and well-structured introduction and training of new employees and we will dedicate a Buddy for you to better navigate in your first weeks
* Your own career path within Sanofi. Your professional and personal development will be supported purposefully
* Join a great community & unique events (Monthly Board Game Nights, Summer Events, Well-Being Lectures & Sport Clubs)

*Pursue Progress, discover Extraordinary*

Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress does not happen without people – people from diverse backgrounds, in various locations, doing distinct roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let us be those people.

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.

Our Technology centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of the company IT operating model, Tech centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each tech center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. title: Senior Product Analyst - Credit Products
description:
### **A****BOUT TIDE**

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

**Tide facts:**

* Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* 3,000 Tideans globally
* Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India's Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**

As a Senior Analyst - Credit Products you'll work closely with Tide's credit product teams to shape credit product and risk decision making. This role will suit an individual that can operate with a high degree of independence and has hands-on experience of proactively taking initiative to uncover insights from data.

As a key member of our team, your role will go beyond merely generating reports; you will be expected to extract meaningful insights from data, enabling informed decision-making that drives our lending strategy. If you have a keen ability to decipher complex credit focused data sets and transform them into actionable insights that guide our decision making, we encourage you to apply for this position and help shape the future of SME lending.

**Some of the things you'll be doing:**

* Data Analysis & Insight Generation: Utilise advanced analytics to derive meaningful insights from complex data sets. Focus on analysing lending product performance, identifying trends, and providing actionable recommendations.
* Credit Risk Management: Monitor and optimise key performance indicators (KPIs) related to credit risk. Develop strategies to mitigate risk while supporting business growth.
* Collaboration with Credit Product Teams: Work closely with product managers and developers to inform and guide the development of new credit products. Use data-driven insights to influence product strategy and design.
* Reporting & Communication: Prepare comprehensive reports and presentations for senior management and stakeholders. Clearly communicate findings and recommendations.
* Continuous Learning & Improvement: Stay abreast of industry trends and advancements in data analytics tools and methodologies. Continuously seek ways to improve our data analysis processes and credit product offerings.

### **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

* 4+ years of experience working as a credit focused analyst or data scientist at a fintech or bank.
* You have expert SQL proficiency and can navigate complex data warehouse relationships
* You are a self starter who takes initiative and can operate with a high degree of independence.
* You have the ability to deal with ambiguity and competing objectives in a fast paced environment.

### **WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN:**

Make work, work for you! We are embracing new ways of working and support flexible working arrangements. With our new Hybrid working model & Working Out of Office (WOO) policy our colleagues can work remotely from home or anywhere in their home country. Additionally, you can work from a different country for 90 days of the year. Plus, you'll get:

* Competitive salary
* Vitality Health Insurance, with a proactive focus on mental and physical wellbeing
* Employee Assistance Programme
* 12 casual & 15 Privilege leaves
* We invest in your development with professional L&D budget per year
* Spacious office in Hitechcity with all day snacks
* 24 hours paid volunteering time off per year
* Hybrid working
* Sabbatical leave

### **TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING**

title: Enterprise Integrations Analyst*
description:
**Description**

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Snowflake / Data Engineer with deep expertise in building scalable, reliable, and high-performance data platforms using Snowflake and AWS.The ideal candidate has strong experience designing production-grade data pipelines, developing complex transformations, modeling enterprise data, optimizing Snowflake workloads, and integrating data from systems such as Salesforce, APIs, SaaS platforms, and AWS services.This role will be responsible for building the data foundation that powers analytics, operational workflows, enterprise integrations, reporting, and AI applications.

**What You'll Do**

### **Snowflake Engineering**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable data solutions on Snowflake
* Develop databases, schemas, tables, views, secure views, stages, and other Snowflake objects
* Build production-grade SQL and Snowpark-based transformations
* Implement Snowflake Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables, Snowpipe, and related capabilities
* Design incremental processing and change-data-capture patterns
* Optimize Snowflake queries, warehouses, clustering strategies, and storage patterns
* Monitor and optimize Snowflake compute consumption and platform costs
* Implement secure data-sharing and access patterns

### **Data Pipeline Development**

* Build robust ETL/ELT pipelines for structured and semi-structured data
* Develop batch, incremental, near-real-time, and event-driven ingestion pipelines
* Integrate data from Salesforce, REST APIs, SaaS applications, AWS, databases, and file-based sources
* Implement reusable ingestion and transformation frameworks
* Build pipelines capable of handling schema evolution, late-arriving data, retries, and replay
* Develop reconciliation processes to ensure source-to-target completeness and accuracy
* Build orchestration workflows with appropriate dependency and failure management

### **Data Modeling**

* Design scalable analytical and operational data models
* Build dimensional models, fact and dimension tables, data marts, and curated datasets
* Translate complex source-system structures into standardized enterprise data models
* Establish consistent definitions for core business entities and metrics
* Design data layers that support analytics, reporting, operational applications, and AI workloads
* Balance performance, usability, maintainability, and storage efficiency in data-model design

### **Salesforce Data Integration**

* Build reliable pipelines ingesting Salesforce objects and related data into Snowflake
* Work with Salesforce APIs, Bulk API, Change Data Capture, and Platform Events where appropriate
* Handle Salesforce relationships, custom objects, schema changes, and large-volume datasets
* Build incremental and CDC-based synchronization patterns
* Implement reconciliation and data-quality controls between Salesforce and Snowflake

### **AWS Integration**

* Build data pipelines using AWS services such as S3, Lambda, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, and related technologies
* Design secure data movement between AWS and Snowflake
* Build event-driven ingestion and processing workflows
* Manage file-based ingestion, staging, and archival patterns
* Implement appropriate IAM, encryption, secrets management, and access controls

### **Data Quality & Observability**

* Implement automated data-quality validation and testing
* Build monitoring for pipeline freshness, completeness, accuracy, and failures
* Implement logging, metrics, alerts, and operational dashboards
* Establish source-to-target reconciliation processes
* Investigate and resolve production data incidents
* Identify upstream and downstream impacts of data changes

### **Performance & Cost Optimization**

* Analyze query profiles and optimize expensive Snowflake workloads
* Optimize warehouse sizing, auto-suspend, auto-resume, and workload isolation
* Improve SQL performance and data-processing efficiency
* Monitor storage and compute consumption
* Identify opportunities to reduce pipeline runtime and infrastructure cost

### **Engineering Excellence**

* Write clean, reusable, testable, and maintainable code
* Participate in architecture and code reviews
* Build automated testing into data pipelines
* Maintain technical documentation, data mappings, and runbooks
* Contribute to CI/CD and automated deployment practices
* Mentor other Data Engineers and help establish engineering standards

**What You'll Bring**

* 5+ years of data engineering experience
* 3+ years of strong hands-on Snowflake experience
* Advanced SQL skills, including complex transformations and query optimization
* Strong Python skills for data processing, automation, and API integrations
* Experience building production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines
* Experience integrating Snowflake with AWS
* Experience ingesting data from Salesforce or similar enterprise SaaS platforms
* Strong understanding of dimensional modeling and modern data architecture
* Experience with incremental processing, CDC, and data reconciliation
* Experience implementing data-quality and monitoring frameworks
* Experience with Git, CI/CD, and software engineering best practices

**Nice-to-Have**

* Experience with Snowpark
* Experience with Snowflake Cortex
* Experience with Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables, Snowpipe, and secure data sharing
* Experience with Salesforce Bulk API, CDC, and Platform Events
* Experience with AWS Lambda, S3, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, and Glue
* Experience with dbt or similar transformation frameworks
* Experience with Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or similar orchestration platforms
* Experience with Terraform or infrastructure-as-code
* Experience supporting AI/ML and RAG workloads from Snowflake
* Snowflake certifications are a plus

**What We Offer**

* Complimentary CalmApp subscription for you and your loved ones, because mental wellness matters.

Evernorth Health Services is the pharmacy, care and benefits solution division of The Cigna Group

**Job Description**

* The Data Builder is the hands-on builder responsible for turning architectural design and business requirements into **trusted, reusable data products through MVP that are production grade.** Reporting to the Director, Data Operations & Data Management, this role builds to the enterprise-agnostic Silver foundation designed by Data Architecture and **co-designs and builds Gold data products** where business logic, metrics, and functional knowledge live.
* This is a hands-on individual contributor role — the **build authority** that blends **business fluency and data engineering discipline in equal measure**, authoring Gold data products that answer the question the first time and building them to production standard.
* This role is a critical execution counterpart to **Data Architecture and Data Analysis, Products & Integration**, building faithfully against their designs and requirements and compressing the path from new data to a production-grade, reusable asset. It is an exciting opportunity to join the team transforming how Cigna builds and reuses data — delivered through MVP.

**Key Responsibilities**

Rapid Build & Delivery

* Build architecture’s designs and analysis’s requirements into **production-ready solutions** through MVP.
* Work new and unfamiliar data quickly into a **working solution** that answers the business question at hand.
* Refactor **learning-stage and bespoke work** into durable, reusable, production-ready assets.

Silver — Build to Architecture’s Design

* Build the physical Silver structures to the **enterprise-agnostic Silver model** and reference patterns designed by Data Architecture.
* Implement the design faithfully and promote it to production through **governed CI/CD pipelines**.
* Capture **business context and metadata** at build, and hand off to trusted partner teams as readiness allows.

Gold — Democratized, Delivered Through MVP

* Treat the Gold layer as **democratized** — Data Operations may own specific Gold assets and assists other teams in building theirs.
* Deliver Gold solutions through **build-through-MVP**, promoted to production-grade through governed CI/CD pipelines regardless of owner.
* Uphold the **build standards and guardrails** any Gold solution must meet, so a federated Gold layer stays stable and production-grade across owning teams.

Engineering Discipline & Production Readiness

* Build to **production standards** from day one so the lift from MVP to production is simple, not a rebuild.
* Apply consistent **development patterns, naming conventions, and build standards** with specific focus on the connectivity across all data products to create a more connected data ecosystem.
* Move work through the CI/CD pipeline — develop, test, and productionize — clearing **quality, security, and cost checks** on first pass.
* Apply **AI and automation** to accelerate build and testing without bypassing governance, security, or quality expectations.

Partnership & Collaboration

* Partner with **Data Architecture** — building to their Silver design and co-designing Gold within the standards they set.
* Partner with **Data Analysis, Products & Integration** — who bring the requirements, business rules, and acceptance criteria this role builds against.
* Partner with **Platform Engineering / IT and DevOps & AI Enablement** — who own ingestion, pipelines, and the automation frameworks this role builds on.
* Partner with **data science and business analytics teams** so Gold data products serve their models, analyses, and decisions.
* Partner with **data governance** **team** to ensure enterprise standards are consistently implemented
* Set the design and hold Data Operations standards across **the Hyderabad Data Operations team** and **outside service partners** as part of a global delivery model.

What This Role Is Not

* Not a pure data engineering or platform role.
* Not the owner of the enterprise Silver model.
* Not the primary business-engagement or requirements role.
* Not the owner of the Gold layer, which is democratized across teams.
* Not a governance policy, stewardship, or BI reporting role.
* This role exists to **build real data solutions that get used** — designed for the business, engineered to last, delivered through MVP.

Required Experience & Capabilities

* **3+ years building production-grade data solutions**, with demonstrated depth in analytics engineering or equivalent business-plus-build work.
* A genuine **50/50 blend of business fluency and hands-on engineering discipline**.
* Hands-on experience with **Databricks, Spark, Unity Catalog, SQL, and Python**.
* Familiarity with **Snowflake and Teradata** in addition to a Databricks-first stack.
* Expert knowledge of **dimensional and medallion (Silver / Gold) modeling** within an enterprise-agnostic data model.
* Working knowledge of **CI/CD pipelines, automated code evaluation, and controlled promotion** to production.
* Strong **software-engineering discipline** — version control (Git), code review, and efficient, reusable code.
* **Performance-tuning and cost-optimizing Spark and SQL transformations** at scale.
* Familiarity with **data governance and cataloging tooling** such as Collibra.
* **Automated data-quality testing and validation** built into every solution.
* Demonstrated ability to **learn a new data domain fast** and turn business logic into reusable data products.
* Demonstrated ability to apply **AI and automation** to accelerate build while preserving quality and governance.
* Experience in **complex, regulated enterprises** preferred; healthcare or PBM data a plus.
* Design and implement **automated data observability and reliability reporting**
* Experience working in regulated or compliance‑driven environments

Measures of Success

* New data reaches a trusted, production-grade asset in a short cycle time.
* Gold data products are delivered and reused across use cases, with democratized ownership held to a common build standard.
* Silver builds implement architecture’s design faithfully and are handed off without loss of quality.
* Solutions reach production through governed CI/CD pipelines, clearing quality, security, and cost gates on first pass.
* Build acceleration through AI and automation is achieved without compromising governance, quality, or security controls.

**Work Hours:**

* 2:30 PM IST to 11.30PM IST

**Equal Opportunity Statement:**

Evernorth Health Services, a division of The Cigna Group, creates pharmacy, care and benefit solutions to improve health and increase vitality. We relentlessly innovate to make the prediction, prevention and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

title: Data Analyst – Identity & Graph Analytics
description:
**Job Role: Data Analyst – Identity & Graph Analytics**
=======================================================

**Location:** Hyderabad, India

**Experience:** 5+ Years

**About Anblicks**
------------------

Anblicks is a Great Place to Work® Certified™ Data and AI company helping enterprises transform data into actionable insights through modern data platforms, cloud technologies, and advanced analytics. We partner with leading technology providers to deliver innovative, scalable, and data-driven solutions.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are looking for a detail-oriented **Data Analyst – Identity & Graph Analytics** with strong expertise in SQL, Python, data quality, and statistical analysis to support the validation and optimization of large-scale Identity Graph products.

In this role, you will analyze complex datasets, evaluate identity resolution results, assess matching accuracy, and identify anomalies across person-level and household-level records. You will collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams to improve identity matching quality, validate graph behavior, and drive continuous product enhancements.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities with hands-on data investigation skills and an interest in identity resolution, entity matching, and graph-based data systems.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Identity Graph Analysis:** Analyze identity resolution outputs and client datasets to identify fragmented identities, duplicate or anomalous person records, and incorrect household groupings.
* **Match Quality Assessment:** Investigate false positives, false negatives, and matching inconsistencies to evaluate identity resolution accuracy.
* **Data Validation & Testing:** Validate graph matching behavior across real-world scenarios, business rules, and identity use cases.
* **SQL & Python Analytics:** Use SQL and Python to query, transform, analyze, and validate large, complex datasets.
* **Benchmarking & Test Data:** Create, maintain, and enhance datasets for graph testing, quality validation, performance benchmarking, and regression analysis.
* **Exploratory Data Analysis:** Perform deep-dive and ad hoc analyses to identify patterns, anomalies, trends, and opportunities for improving graph quality.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams to investigate issues and recommend improvements to matching accuracy and graph performance.
* **Statistical Measurement:** Support the evaluation of match quality using metrics such as precision, recall, false-positive rate, and false-negative rate.
* **Reporting & Insights:** Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and documentation highlighting graph quality, validation results, performance trends, and improvement opportunities.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Support testing backlogs, validation workflows, quality monitoring, and research initiatives in collaboration with the Lead Data Scientist.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
------------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field.
* **5+ years of experience** in data analytics, data quality, data validation, or a related analytical role.
* Strong proficiency in **SQL**, including complex queries, joins, aggregations, data profiling, and analysis of large datasets.
* Hands-on experience with **Python or R** for data analysis, data manipulation, and statistical evaluation.
* Strong understanding of data quality assessment, data validation techniques, and exploratory data analysis.
* Experience identifying duplicates, inconsistencies, anomalies, and patterns across complex datasets.
* Knowledge of statistical analysis and data-driven problem-solving techniques.
* Ability to translate analytical findings into actionable insights and communicate results clearly to technical and business stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail, critical thinking, and a structured approach to investigating data issues.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience in **identity resolution, entity matching, record linkage, or customer identity analytics**.
* Familiarity with identity graphs, graph-based systems, relationship mapping, or large-scale data processing platforms.
* Understanding of person-level identity, householding, customer profiles, and identity matching logic.
* Experience designing test datasets, benchmark datasets, and regression testing scenarios for data-intensive products.
* Practical knowledge of match-quality metrics, including precision, recall, F1-score, and false-positive/false-negative analysis.
* Exposure to Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), MarTech, AdTech, or identity intelligence solutions.
* Experience working with cloud-based data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, or equivalent technologies.

**What Makes You a Good Fit?**
------------------------------

* You enjoy investigating complex datasets and uncovering hidden patterns and inconsistencies.
* You can combine SQL, Python, and statistical analysis to evaluate data quality and matching accuracy.
* You are comfortable working with large-scale data and translating findings into practical recommendations.
* You collaborate effectively with technical teams to solve data quality challenges and improve product performance.

description:

**ABOUT AMGEN**

Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting\-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**


The Project Controls, Engineering Analytics \& Bid Review will be based in AIN and will be part of the Project Controls organization within Amgen Engineering. This role will report to the Senior Manager – Capital Equipment Analytics and will support capital equipment analytics and bid review activities across global capital projects.


This role will combine project controls, analytics, reporting, and capital equipment bid review experience to improve cost visibility, supplier comparison, equipment demand insights, and decision support. The Project Controls Analytics role will help structure bid information, analyse supplier proposals, support benchmarking, and develop analytics outputs that improve project planning, equipment delivery visibility, and risk identification.


The role will also support compliance to established project controls, procurement, and reporting processes by maintaining reliable data, clear analytical assumptions, and audit\-ready supporting documentation.

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**

* Support capital equipment bid review, including cost comparison, schedule / lead\-time review, scope completeness, assumptions, exclusions, and risk indicators.
* Support benchmarking by comparing current bids against historical project and equipment data to identify cost trends, variance drivers, supplier differences, and forecasting inputs.
* Support reporting, analytics, and decision\-support tools that improve visibility into equipment demand, spend, bid comparisons, supplier risks, delivery milestones, and lifecycle status.
* Support the equipment data foundation by collecting, validating, and maintaining bid, supplier, cost, demand, schedule, delivery, and lifecycle data.
* Maintain audit\-ready analysis files, data records, assumptions, and supporting documentation in alignment with established project controls and procurement processes.
* Use digital, automation, and AI\-enabled tools to improve analysis quality, reporting efficiency, data review, and insight generation.
* Partner with Project Controls, Engineering, Procurement, Finance, and project teams to gather inputs, validate assumptions, and align analytical outputs.
* Support bid review templates, reporting standards, analytics methods, and data quality practices.

**Basic Qualifications and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent).
* 5–9 years of work experience in Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field
* Experience in the global pharmaceutical industry preferred.

**Functional Skills**

* Project controls and analytics experience in a capital project, engineering, procurement, or estimating environment.
* Support bid review, cost comparison, benchmarking, forecasting, reporting, or supplier proposal analysis.
* Ability to review capital equipment bids and interpret cost, scope, schedule, assumptions, exclusions, delivery risks, and comparison points.
* Experience with digital tools for reporting and analytics such as Power BI, advanced Excel, SAP, procurement / sourcing systems, data structuring, or similar platforms.
* Understanding of data integrity, process compliance, documentation discipline, and audit readiness in project controls, analytics, or procurement\-related workflows.
* Understanding of capital project cost, schedule, procurement, and supplier delivery information.
* Ability to partner effectively with Engineering, Project Controls, Procurement, Finance, and project teams.

**Good\-to\-Have Skills:**

* Experience supporting capital projects in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life sciences, advanced manufacturing, or other regulated industries.
* Experience working with capital equipment, supplier bids, procurement data, or equipment lifecycle information.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled productivity and analytics tools such as ChatGPT, Codex, VS Code extensions, or similar tools.
* Experience developing bid review templates, reporting standards, data models, or analytical tools.
* Familiarity with automation, advanced analytics, data quality improvement, or scalable reporting practices.

**Professional Certifications:**

* Relevant certification in project management, project controls, cost management, analytics, engineering, or a related discipline

**Soft Skills:**

* Analytical thinking and attention to detail.
* Communication and presentation skills.
* Problem\-solving mindset, and willingness to adopt new tools and ways of working.
* Ability deliver high\-quality work under timelines.

description:

**Job Summary**


We are seeking a highly skilled **Analytics \& AI Engineer** to support executives and business leaders by delivering advanced analytics, AI\-powered insights, and enterprise reporting solutions. As an Analytics \& AI Engineer, you will play a critical role in shaping the organization's analytics strategy and enabling data\-driven decision\-making across Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Sales, Service, Marketing, Finance, HR, and Connected Vehicle Operations.


You will leverage **Tableau, Amazon Redshift, Python, AI technologies, and modern analytics practices** to develop sophisticated dashboards, executive scorecards, forecasting models, self\-service analytics solutions, and AI\-driven insights that improve business performance and operational efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise Tableau dashboards, executive scorecards, KPI frameworks, and analytical applications.
